title: Quality & Sustainability Manager
location: King Abdullah Economic City, Saudi Arabia
description:
Company Description
Established in 2000 in Turkey, Rixos pioneers the 'ALL Inclusive, ALL Exclusive' concept, inviting guests to discover a world of possibilities with luxurious stays, culinary experiences, live entertainment, sports and fitness activities, spa and wellness journeys, and kids and teens activities.

Job Description
Lead and oversee quality and sustainability initiatives across the property. Manage and improve quality control systems, ensure compliance with industry standards, and drive sustainability programs aimed at reducing environmental impact. Collaborate with departments to promote high service standards and environmental responsibility. Responsibilities include developing and monitoring quality management systems, executing sustainability strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, training team members, conducting audits and inspections, managing sustainability programs, coordinating cross-functional improvements, reporting performance to management, and identifying cost-saving and innovation opportunities.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in quality management or sustainability roles, preferably in hospitality. Strong knowledge of sustainability practices, environmental regulations, quality management systems, leadership, analysis, communication, budgeting, and continuous improvement.
